annotations.annotation_text: Page 219 opens Book 2, Chapter 1 ("The Mime of Mick, Nick and the Maggies") during the Age of Heroes phase. This passage continues the children's games and pantomime on the green, Chuff vs. Glugg, the twenty-eight Rainbow Girls, the Angelus bell, featuring Shem (Glugg), Shaun (Chuff), Issy, the Maggies. The nocturnal dream-narrative layers Dublin topography, world mythology, and linguistic alchemy into polysemic prose.
sources: Campbell, Joseph and Robinson, Henry Morton. A Skeleton Key to Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/skeletonkeytofin00camp
McHugh, Roland. Annotations to Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/annotationstofin0000mchu_h5g8
Gordon, John. Finnegans Wake: A Plot Summary. https://johngordonfinnegan.weebly.com
JJDA: Finnegans Wake Genetic Edition. https://jjda.ie

annotations.annotation_text: Book II, Chapter 1 opening (219.01): the children perform a twilight pantomime on the green outside HCE's tavern, enacting the archetypal conflict of light and darkness through traditional children's games.
sources: Campbell, Joseph and Robinson, Henry Morton. A Skeleton Key. https://archive.org/details/skeletonkeytofin00camp

annotations.annotation_text: Glugg vs. Chuff (219.10): Shem appears as Glugg (Nick / Lucifer / the sullen outsider) and Shaun as Chuff (Mick / Archangel Michael / the sunny favorite).
sources: Atherton, James S. The Books at the Wake. https://archive.org/details/booksatwake0000athe

annotations.annotation_text: The riddle game (219.18): Glugg must guess the secret color worn by the 28 rainbow girls within three tries or be cast into outer darkness.
sources: Opie, Iona and Peter. Children's Games in Street and Playground. https://archive.org/details/childrensgames0000unse

annotations.annotation_text: The secret color "heliotrope" (219.25): Greek 'helios' (sun) + 'trepein' (to turn). The purple flower and solar dye representing divine illumination, which Glugg's earthly intellect cannot guess.
sources: Contemporary Literature Press: Classical Lexicon. https://editura.mttlc.ro
